targets.expr:
label_replace (sum by (http_host,cache_status) (increase(cc_http_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"$pod"} [5m]))
* on(http_host) group_left topk(10, sum by (http_host) (increase(cc_http_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"$pod"} [5m]))) ^ 0 > 0, "kind", "$1", "cache_status", "(.*)")

label_replace (sum by (http_host,http_status) (increase(cc_http_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"$pod"} [5m]))
* on(http_host) group_left topk(10, sum by (http_host) (increase(cc_http_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"$pod"} [5m]))) ^ 0 > 0, "kind", "$1", "http_status", "(.*)")
